diagram_previews.alt: Right triangle ABC with the right angle at C, legs CA = 8 (split by Q into CQ = 2 and QA = 6) and CB = 6 (split by P into CP = 2 and PB = 4); the blue cevians AP, BQ and CS meet at R, and S divides AB into AS = 6 and SB = 4.

difficulty_rationale: Needs Ceva for the cevian foot and Menelaus (or coordinates) for the external point, recognising that S and T divide AB in the same ratio.
